scoring_justification: No intermediate recomputable raw artifacts; the only output is the final mobility values. Comparing to paper-reported reference with tolerances is the feasible verification.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold low-field electron mobilities for InAs, InSb, AlSb, Al0.15In0.85Sb
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported values: InAs 28,000 cm²/V·s, InSb 67,000 cm²/V·s, AlSb 525 cm²/V·s, Al0.15In0.85Sb 9,400 cm²/V·s (text and Fig. 1 caption).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's headline numeric results, not fabricated.

outputs.description: Electron low-field mobility values for four bulk semiconductors, computed from MC simulation. Checked against paper-reported reference within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Only bulk mobility reproduction is scored; heterostructure simulations are excluded as they require a non-public 2D MC simulator.

steps.description: Validate mobilities.json and compare each mobility to paper reference with tolerances
